$schemaDescription: Single source of truth for the BLE telemetry notification packet sent by moto-connectivity-node to moto-mobile. Implementations: src/BLETelemetryPacket.h (firmware) and moto-mobile lib/models/telemetry_data.dart (decoder, with a copy of this file under test/fixtures/ checked by a test). Ported from HondaCl250_Telemetry@legacy-final (version 1) per D-023.

versioning.rule: Receivers MUST read `version` first and drop the packet if it does not match the version they were built against. Any change to field order, size or meaning requires incrementing `version` here and in both implementations together.

history.1: Legacy layout (15 bytes). Lean fields came from the dropped complementary filter.
history.2: Lean fields keep their offsets but carry `notAvailable` until the rt-core EKF lean estimate reaches this node (D-023); byte 15 `flags` added so receivers can show stale values as unavailable.

sequenceNumber.rule: Rolls over 0-255. Receivers track the last seen seq and compute (currentSeq - lastSeq - 1) mod 256 as the number of packets lost since the previous one.

notAvailable.rule: A lean field equal to -32768 (0x8000) means no value is available; receivers must not display it as a number.

flags.rule: A value whose bit is 0 is stale or was never received; receivers show it as unavailable instead of the number.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Packet format version, must equal `version` above.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Rolling 0-255 counter incremented once per packet sent.

fields.name: rpm
fields.description: Engine speed in rpm (integer part), range 0-16383.

fields.name: coolantTemp
fields.description: Coolant temperature in degrees Celsius, range -40 to 127 (higher values are clamped to 127).

fields.name: batteryVolt
fields.description: Battery voltage in millivolts, e.g. 12400 = 12.4 V.

fields.name: leanAngle
fields.description: Lean (roll) angle in tenths of a degree, positive = right side down; -32768 = not available.

fields.name: maxLeanRight
fields.description: Peak right lean angle in tenths of a degree; -32768 = not available.

fields.name: maxLeanLeft
fields.description: Peak left lean angle in tenths of a degree; -32768 = not available.
